page.notes: Long s is printed as f throughout and has been rendered as plain s (e.g. "fuadet", "fingula", "fiat", "fe-"). Several words are uncertain because of print and are not marked here with [?]: "iã" (possibly "iam"), "iure iã", "uelex", "controuerfiis", "diferte uetitam alege" (likely "a lege"). Printed numbers and references are copied as printed: "12", "§.1.", "L.r.", "in L.", "uetat". Catchword "fiue" is printed at lower right. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Vlp.", "iniust." Line-end hyphens kept.
